Do not use MCP1703 SOT-23 for this rail

The current +5 V LDO must dissipate the LED-rail voltage drop. A 5 V → 3.3 V SOT-23 LDO would instead dissipate the 3.3 V rail loss shown above. The conservative peak envelope combines events that may not be simultaneous; it is a supply-sizing bound, not a continuous-load claim.

Recommended next step: measure the 3.3 V rail in GNSS acquisition, microSD write and CAN dominant traffic. Keep the LMR33610 as the 3.3 V buck unless measured current and thermal testing justify a smaller linear rail.
